ENGINE MECHANICAL (2JZ-GTE) - TIMING BELT

4. INSTALL TIMING BELT GUIDE
Install the guide, facing the cup side outward.
5. INSTALL NO.1 TIMING BELT COVER

S00263

6. INSTALL CRANKSHAFT PULLEY
(a) Align the pulley set key with the key groove of the pulley,
and slide on the pulley.
(b) Using SST, install the bolt.
SST 09213-70010, 09330-00021
Torque: 324 N·m (3,300 kgf·cm, 239 ft·lbf)
7. A/T:
CONNECT OIL COOLER TUBES

SST
SST
S00268

8. INSTALL CAMSHAFT TIMING PULLEYS
(a) Align the camshaft knock pin with the groove of the pulley,
and slide on the timing pulley.
(b) Temporarily install the timing pulley bolt.

P03960

(c) Using SST, tighten the pulley bolt.
SST 09960-10010 (09962-01000, 09963-01000)
Torque: 79 N·m (810 kgf·cm, 59 ft·lbf)

SST
A02559

9. SET NO.1 CYLINDER TO TDC/COMPRESSION
(a) Turn the crankshaft pulley, and align its groove with timing
mark "0" of the No.1 timing belt cover.
NOTICE:
Always turn the crankshaft clockwise.

S00394
